selected_evidence.summary: Apache is enabled and listening on port 8080; authenticated PROPFIND returns /documents/, budget.csv, and brief.txt before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Editor can create, read, replace, and delete documents
selected_evidence.summary: Observed create 201, correct read content, replacement 204 with updated content, deletion 204, and subsequent 404.

selected_evidence.requirement: Exclusive locks prevent updates without the lock token
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, LOCK returned 200 and a token, tokenless PUT returned 423, token-bearing PUT returned 204, and UNLOCK returned 204.

selected_evidence.requirement: Anonymous clients cannot access the workspace
selected_evidence.summary: Anonymous GET and PROPFIND requests returned 401, including after reboot; authenticated requests returned 200/207.
The initial tree was captured before changes; served/source hashes match, and budget.csv plus brief.txt remain after tests and reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 24.04.3 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic remain unchanged; Apache 2.4.58 was installed from the compatible Ubuntu repository.

Baseline boot ID f9bf293d-1eb8-423e-b185-84e94db646f3 was captured, reboot was acknowledged, the new boot ID a89d3daf-df51-4855-8a9b-ff98232cd4b3 was observed, and service, authentication, data, listener, and lock enforcement all recovered.
